name: Vernonia

project_scope.selection_mode: B089 hybrid anchor + B161 strict parent review
project_scope.note: All four current source concepts are scientifically dispositioned. Vernonia × guadalupensis is canonical; plain V. guadalupensis is its source alias; V. baldwinii and V. lindheimeri independently PASS the strict three-target-county gate (Travis, Williamson, Kerr) and await user approval before installation.

priority: intermediate characters in the natural hybrid
study_strategy.warning: Do not force intermediate plants into either parent. Vernonia × guadalupensis is an accepted natural hybrid between V. baldwinii and V. lindheimeri. V. baldwinii is the much broader-leaved parent; V. lindheimeri has very narrow linear, strongly revolute leaves densely woolly beneath. Mature flowering material and nearby parent populations are important.

quick_comparison: V. baldwinii — taller robust western ironweed; much broader ovate to lance-ovate foliage, hairy/tomentose beneath; B161 strict PASS (Travis, Williamson, Kerr), pending user approval.

V. lindheimeri — woolly ironweed; very narrow linear strongly revolute leaves, densely sericeo-tomentose beneath and usually glabrate above; B161 strict PASS (Travis, Williamson, Kerr), pending user approval.
V. × guadalupensis — accepted natural hybrid; intermediate characters can bridge the parents; canonical PASS.
